verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party developer pages document official SDKs for building on Apple silicon. These include Metal with its debugger and Metal Performance Shaders Graph, Core ML for integrating models into apps, MLX for training and fine-tuning generative models, and PyTorch backends for GPU training, with Xcode named for app building. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs on M4 Pro, AI-native doc affordances (the llms.txt probe returned 404), and deeper SDK documentation beyond marketing-level snippets.
